description: This file defines the ContactsListViewSmarty class, which extends ListViewSmarty to customize list view behavior for contacts, including processing template files and building export links with map integration.

classes.name: ContactsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A custom list view class for displaying contacts, extending ListViewSmarty with additional functionalities such as processing templates and generating export links with map support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list view and sets targetList to true.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a given template file with data and generates export links, including optional confirmation email actions.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Builds an export link with embedded map interface, conditionally allowing export based on access rights.
